purpose: Route enabled new-system autosaves through the same read-only capture and file export as -savef; preserve legacy behavior only when the new save is disabled. No payload fields or item/job identities change.
verification: Autosave driver dispatches through FFL_Autosave and the shared FFL_BeginSave path. Busy, locked, Hardcore and opted-out players are skipped; the legacy writer is not called in the enabled new system.
